hero_text: Grinffindor supports the Grin community with open tools and infrastructure. Explore testnet and mainnet faucets, run your own Grin node on UmbrelOS, and find everything you need to use, test, and build with Grin.
explorer_page_intro: Do you want to track transactions, analyze blocks, or get an overview of the Grin network? Then use the official block explorer:
explorer_feature_transactions_body: View transactions and verify details when you want to follow activity on the network more closely.
explorer_feature_blocks_title: Track Block Heights and Network Status
explorer_feature_blocks_body: Follow block heights and keep an eye on the current network status directly from the explorer.
explorer_feature_network_body: Use the explorer to access broader network information and get a quick operational overview of Grin.
exchange_page_intro: Do you want to trade or acquire GRIN? Here you will find a selection of exchanges where GRIN is currently available:
exchange_nonlongs_body: Access the platform directly and review its available GRIN markets, trading flow, and account requirements.
exchange_gate_body: Check the exchange for GRIN availability, market depth, and the specific trading options offered on the platform.
exchange_noirtrade_body: Review the service details, supported GRIN access paths, and the platform conditions before using it.
exchange_note_body: Please note that each platform offers different features, fee structures, and liquidity. Before using any exchange, review the relevant conditions and security measures carefully.
support_page_intro: Do you have questions, need help, or ran into a problem? No problem - we are here for you.
support_page_telegram_intro: For fast and direct support and for reporting bugs, please use our Telegram community:
support_topic_bug_body: Let us know when something is broken, behaves unexpectedly, or produces an error so problems can be tracked and fixed quickly.
support_topic_help_title: Get Help with Wallet, Node, or Bot
support_topic_help_body: Ask for direct support if you need help using the wallet, setting up a node, or working with the bots and related tools.
support_topic_feedback_body: Bring in feedback, ideas for improvements, and practical suggestions that can make the platform better for everyone.
support_topic_exchange_body: Use the group to exchange with other users and developers, compare setups, and resolve issues together.
support_goal_body: Our goal is to identify problems quickly and find solutions together.
support_note_body: The more precise your description is, including logs, screenshots, or error messages, the faster we can help.
grinffindor_page_intro: Grinffindor is your gateway into the world of Grin and Mimblewimble - a community-driven platform built to make privacy-focused cryptocurrency accessible, practical, and easy to use.
grinffindor_metric_body_1: Infrastructure and entry points for everyday Grin usage.
grinffindor_metric_body_2: Built to support experimentation and real network activity.
grinffindor_metric_body_3: A platform shaped by contributors, users, and builders.
grinffindor_feature_seed_body: Mainnet and Testnet seed infrastructure to support a stable and decentralized Grin network.
grinffindor_feature_umbrel_body: Run your own Grin node at home with straightforward setup guidance and practical documentation.
grinffindor_feature_testnet_body: Experiment, learn, and build without risk while getting familiar with the Grin ecosystem.
grinffindor_feature_mainnet_body: Bring real value into everyday interactions and make Grin more tangible in practice.
grinffindor_feature_shop_body: Curated tools, hardware, and community merchandise designed around practical Grin usage.
grinffindor_feature_ecosystem_body: Whether you run your first node, test transactions, or integrate Grin into your own projects, Grinffindor supports the full journey.
grinffindor_section_whats_new_sub: A focused set of tools and services for getting into Grin.
grinffindor_community_body: Grinffindor is more than just infrastructure - it is a growing ecosystem designed to empower the Grin community. We believe in privacy, simplicity, and decentralization, and everything we build reflects these principles.
grinffindor_section_journey_sub: Four simple steps into the ecosystem.
umbrel_page_intro: Grinffindor brings the power of Grin infrastructure directly into your home server through a custom UmbrelOS integration.
umbrel_page_store_intro: With our dedicated Community App Store, you can easily install and manage Grin-related services in just a few clicks - no complex setup required.
umbrel_store_cta_note: Template / concept basis for community stores
umbrel_feature_os_body: UmbrelOS is a modern self-hosted home server operating system that lets you run apps through a simple web interface. It is Linux-based, accessible for beginners, and powerful enough for advanced users. All applications run in isolated Docker containers, making them secure, modular, and easy to maintain.
umbrel_feature_store_body: Grinffindor provides its own Umbrel Community App Store, enabling the distribution of custom Grin services outside of the official Umbrel ecosystem. Community stores can be added via GitHub URL and allow independent developers to distribute apps freely without official store approval.
umbrel_feature_install_body: Install Grin nodes, tools, and services directly via the Umbrel UI, extend your Umbrel with Grin-specific functionality, and avoid manual CLI setup.
umbrel_feature_adds_body: Run Grin Mainnet and Testnet nodes directly on Umbrel, use integrated wallet and tipping services, access faucets for testing and onboarding, connect via QR codes and web interfaces, and operate a full Grin setup with minimal effort.
umbrel_setup_step_2: Add the Grinffindor Community App Store via GitHub URL.
umbrel_setup_step_3: Install the desired apps with one click.
umbrel_setup_note: No deep technical knowledge required - everything runs in a clean, user-friendly interface.
umbrel_ownership_point_2: Full ownership of your node and funds
mainnet_bot_page_intro: The Mainnet Bot brings Grin interactions directly into Telegram, giving users access to faucet, tipping, wallet, and market functions from a simple chat interface.
mainnet_bot_page_store_intro: The bot is built for practical everyday use and gives the Grin community a lightweight interface for interacting with mainnet services.
testnet_bot_page_intro: The Testnet Bot combines faucet access and tipping features in Telegram so users can learn, test, and experiment with Grin workflows safely.
testnet_bot_page_store_intro: It is the faster playground for onboarding, testing, and validating tipping and wallet flows before they move into broader use.
mainnet_bot_core_body: Use start for the introduction, address for your Slatepack address, donate and donatepack for donations, faucet and faucetpack for faucet access, rewindhash and scanrewindhash for rewind tooling.
mainnet_bot_market_body: Use price for the USDT price, orderbook for the current order book, chart for the 4h USDT chart, and history for the last 10 USDT trades.
mainnet_bot_wallet_body: Use deposit and withdraw with an amount, tip another Telegram user, view tipping info, inspect your ledger, and check your balance directly in chat.
mainnet_bot_usage_body: The bot is designed to make mainnet Grin easier to access in everyday use, combining faucet, interaction, and lightweight wallet workflows in one place.
mainnet_bot_commands: start, address, donate, donatepack, faucet, faucetpack, rewindhash, scanrewindhash, price, orderbook, chart, history, deposit, withdraw, tip, tipping, ledger, balance
mainnet_bot_journey_step_1: Check the faucet and donation flows.
mainnet_bot_journey_step_2: Use market tools directly inside Telegram.
mainnet_bot_journey_step_3: Tip other users and track your balance.
mainnet_bot_journey_step_4: Keep Grin interactions lightweight and accessible.
mainnet_bot_journey_footer: Open Telegram, start the bot, and bring Grin into everyday conversations.
testnet_bot_core_body: Use start for the introduction, address for your Slatepack address, donate and donatepack for donations, faucet and faucetpack for faucet access, rewindhash and scanrewindhash for rewind tooling.
testnet_bot_tipping_body: Last week the testnet bot was extended with tipping functionality. Deposit, withdraw, and tip are available and currently in the testing phase.
testnet_bot_technical_body: The wallet runs in a separate account and path. Tips are executed off-chain between Telegram users. Deposits and withdrawals use Slatepacks.
testnet_bot_market_body: Use price, orderbook, chart, and history for market data, and use tipping, ledger, and balance to inspect bot-side wallet activity.
testnet_bot_commands: start, address, donate, donatepack, faucet, faucetpack, rewindhash, scanrewindhash, price, orderbook, chart, history, deposit, withdraw, tip, tipping, ledger, balance
testnet_bot_journey_step_1: Use the faucet to onboard and test quickly.
testnet_bot_journey_step_2: Deposit and withdraw with Slatepack-based flows.
testnet_bot_journey_step_3: Tip Telegram users off-chain during the testing phase.
testnet_bot_journey_step_4: Validate new Grin interactions before wider rollout.
testnet_bot_journey_footer: The testnet bot is the practical sandbox for learning, trying new flows, and improving the Grin user experience.

settings_intro: Adjust the app configuration to match your preferred language and usage.
settings_language_note: Choose the language used across the interface.
settings_auto_lock_note: Lock the wallet automatically when the app loses focus or is minimized.
browser_wallet_intro: A self-custodial Grin wallet shell for Qt WASM. Seed and slate handling stay local in the browser runtime, while chain data comes from an external node.
browser_wallet_mnemonic_placeholder: 24-word mnemonic for importing an existing wallet.
browser_wallet_node_note: The wallet uses the configured Grin foreign API endpoint for chain access. Local scanning, transaction assembly, broadcast tracking, and recipient-encrypted Slatepacks are active when the wallet is unlocked.
browser_wallet_utxo_note: Tracked outputs, their wallet state, and the commitments currently held in the local wallet.
browser_wallet_utxo_empty: No wallet outputs are tracked yet. Run a scan or complete a transaction first.
browser_wallet_slatepack_note: Start a SEND flow at S1 or a RECEIVE invoice flow at I1. Paste the counterparty Slatepack into the single exchange field and advance it locally until S3 or I3.
browser_wallet_statement_entries_note: Credit and debit entries are shown with sign, timestamp, status and workflow reference.
browser_wallet_statement_empty: No statement entries are available yet. Complete or receive a transaction first.
